body: If you had to pick ONE song that represents the sound of LA, what would it be? asked the crowd at FX and UPROXX’s The Drop: A Snowfall Saga celebration at the world-famous VIP Records to name the ultimate LA anthem. The answers? Pure West Coast energy. FX’s The Drop is now streaming on FXPartner.
